Name: JumJum Jr. Rises Again
Author: scorcher9009
Description:
JumJum Jr. rises again![url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/197]


[/url]﻿This mod is a remake of ProJared's original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/197]original mod[/url] for 1.6.
Except this time, instead of replacing Rarecrow #8, he is now his own, unique item!

And this time, he even has his own unique niche to set him apart from other Scarecrows: He is also a light source! [s]Because he has a Jack O Lantern head, and people usually put some kind of light in those.[/s] To show off his divine glory, of course!



﻿In order to obtain our dark protector, you just need to befriend Abigail, who will then send you a letter containing our glorious king.








Credit goes to ProJared﻿, for not only making the original mod, but also introducing me to Stardew Valley in the first place!

Manifest.Name: (CP) JumJum Jr. - Non Replacer
Manifest.Description: Adds the glorious JumJum Jr. as a brand new scarecrow, without replacing anything.
